features.title: Restock requests
features.body: Your team can now ask for items to be restocked, or for new items to buy, from Inventory, a product page or the plus button. Repeat asks stack on the same request, and the list shows what to buy, what's ordered and what's arrived.

features.title: Replacements and Refunds pages
features.body: Cases now has Replacements and Refunds pages next to Returns, with date filters, search and lists grouped by day. On phones, Cases, Returns, Replacements and Refunds share one bottom bar.

fixes: Restock a variant from the product page in a pop-up, without leaving the page.
Returns sits under Cases in the web side menu.
The web side menu now stays on order, product, customer and other detail pages.
Case emails now show in the case Activity, and the Customer updates card is tidier.
Returns has the new summary card style.

features.title: Email customers about their case
features.body: A new Customer updates card on each case sends a professional "case opened" email with a summary you can edit. Replacements, refunds, credits and resolutions can email the customer too, with tracking links and amounts in your currency. Internal notes are never shared.

features.title: Colours for your team
features.body: Each teammate now has their own colour in Assign case and comments, so names are easier to tell apart.

fixes: Even spacing between cards on the case page on phones.
Smaller status pill on the case page on phones.
Tidier Replacement card: clearer item names and matching button text.

features.title: Send a replacement from a case
features.body: When an item arrives damaged, open the case and tap Send replacement. Fyll creates a free order with the same customer and address, takes the items from stock and links it to the case and the original order. Replacements never count as sales.

features.title: See which orders have a case
features.body: Orders with an open case now show a Case open chip in the list and on the order page, and you can filter the list to Has open case. The order keeps its own status.

features.title: Your currency on customer pages
features.body: Tracking and quote pages now show amounts in your business's currency, not just Naira.

fixes: Save Changes on an order turns lime when you have unsaved changes, and Shipping label is now an outlined button.
Order update messages now show in Fyll lime.
On web, Add Resolution on a case now sits in the right column under the status.

features.title: Stock movement in Insights
features.body: See units sold, sales and restocks per product over 30 days, 90 days, a year or all time, from the Inventory tab in Insights.

features.title: Restocks, by variant
features.body: The Restocks card now shows every restock with a date filter and a total for each colour or variant, and it is on your phone too.

features.title: Website sales in product activity
features.body: Orders from your Storefront and WooCommerce now appear in a product's activity and sold counts, labelled by where they came from.

fixes: The Restocks tab in product activity now shows your restocks instead of 0, with a Show more button for older entries.
Edit fulfillment now matches the new Fyll look.
The orders list shows a shorter item summary.
Smaller, tidier text on mobile across Inventory, Threads and product pages.
The partner Issues and Partners pages no longer show a divider under the header.

features.title: Edit variants on your phone
features.body: Every variant now has a small menu button. Tap it to edit the variant's image, name, SKU, price and stock, restock it, print its label or delete it.

features.title: Product and variant editors, in the new look
features.body: Edit product, Add variant and Edit variant now fill the screen on a phone with the Fyll styling and new on/off switches.

features.title: Payment pages that fit your country
features.body: Bank account details and public payment links now follow your business region, and customers can add an optional postcode at checkout.

features.title: Prices in your own currency
features.body: Orders, products, quotes and checkout now show amounts in your business currency.

fixes: Notices on Home that need your approval are now evenly spaced.

features.title: Fyll Print, redesigned
features.body: A new print queue with a swipeable preview of every label, copies and parcels, and a shipping label with weight and switches. Saved files are named after the customer and order.

features.title: Smarter bottom navigation
features.body: Print, Cases and Fulfillment now give you a clean page with a round Home button. Finance, Insights and Customers share their own small nav, with the page you are on highlighted.

features.title: Insights, redesigned
features.body: A new headline card for each tab with a plain sentence about your numbers, a Today card beside it on the web, simpler date filters, and the new Fyll fonts and colors on every Insights page.

features.title: A new delivery confirmation page
features.body: Customers who scan the QR on a shipping label open a page with their order already filled in and confirm in one tap. It carries your business logo and name, and they can also track the order or message you on WhatsApp.

features.title: Faster ways to add things in Finance
features.body: The plus button on Finance now offers a new expense, refund or procurement, and Upload receipt to have Fyll AI draft an expense or purchase order from a photo.

fixes: Average order values no longer show decimals on Insights.
The scan sheet is taller, with bigger buttons and a quantity picker when adding stock.
Editing an order now uses the same screen as creating one.
Customer names and amounts on the Customers list are easier to read on a phone.

features.title: Pick up orders
features.body: Choose Delivery or Pick up on a new order. Pick up skips the address and delivery fee, and can have its own fulfillment timeline in Settings.

features.title: Your store link on Home
features.body: A compact store link card now sits at the top of Home, with Copy and Open store.

features.title: A calmer Home
features.body: The setup checklist is compact and collapsible, tiles are plain, and Needs you today closes once everything is handled.

features.title: Fresh Settings
features.body: Settings pages, WhatsApp settings and switches now match the new Fyll look.

fixes: The variants table on a product no longer overlaps on iPad and narrow windows.
The Team step in the setup checklist now opens your team page.
Fyll Checkout payments now alert as "New Fyll Checkout payment" on your website, instead of a storefront order. Card payments are alerted too.
Orders from your own website now say "website order" instead of "Fyll storefront".
Opening a link from an alert while signed out now takes you to that page after you sign in.
Fyll Ops now checks for updates in the background far less often, so it runs lighter and your data stays fast.
Background checks now pause while the app is closed or in the background.

features.title: Order milestones
features.body: Celebrate 100, 500, 1,000 orders and beyond. Owners and admins get a celebration screen when a milestone is reached.

features.title: Share to Story
features.body: Turn a milestone into a ready-made 1080 x 1920 card with your business name and storefront link, and share it in one tap.

features.title: Replay any time
features.body: Settings > System > Replay milestone celebration plays your latest milestone again.

fixes: Settings icons now use the Fyll lime colour everywhere.
Home tiles are plain in light mode instead of tinted.
Buttons on the start page use the Fyll display font.

features.title: Settings, reorganised
features.body: A new Settings sidebar groups everything, with search and an All features page where you can switch tools on or off.

features.title: Fulfillment Timelines
features.body: Order timelines and shipping zones are now one setting. Pick the states each timeline covers.

features.title: Fresh look for Tasks and Settings
features.body: Tasks, Settings and both sidebars now match the new Fyll style on web and mobile.

fixes: WhatsApp alerts are now one per order: Fyll Checkout and Social Checkout send a payment alert, Storefront sends an order alert, and approving a payment sends nothing.
Orders you add by hand no longer send a WhatsApp alert.

features.title: Better payment links
features.body: Customers now pay in three clear steps: details, pay, then receipt. You also get their contact details before they pay.

features.title: Mark as received
features.body: Customer paid but never uploaded a receipt? Confirm the payment yourself from the payment page or the ⋮ menu.

features.title: Payments on Home
features.body: Staff now see their latest payments, and a pending chip shows payments waiting from the last 3 days.

features.title: New partner portal
features.body: The partner portal has a fresh look, jobs and bills grouped by day, and notifications settings.

fixes: Staff no longer see stock value; they see total units in stock instead.
Unread badges on Threads, Cases and the bell no longer pile up from old or closed threads.
Mark all read now stays marked, with a confirmation.
Social Checkout orders no longer send a repeat new order or new storefront order alert after the payment alert.
Order headers now show where an order really came from.
Customer names are capitalised consistently across orders, payments and Home.
Bills under Partners are hidden from staff.

features.title: Faster Fyll Checkout approvals
features.body: Approving a storefront payment now finishes right away while the rest syncs in the background.

features.title: Custom items go to inventory
features.body: Items you add on the fly in an order are saved to your inventory so you can reuse them.

features.title: A fresher Home
features.body: New Payments collected card, quicker Jump to tiles and a cleaner Needs you today.

fixes: Storefront payments now show as paid in Fyll Ops once the order is approved.
WooCommerce fields are hidden when WooCommerce is not connected.
Page headers, tabs and empty states now look the same across Payments, Delivery, Returns and Partners.
The active item in the left menu is now Fyll lime.
